statement.zh: 教科文将特奥蒂瓦坎表述为墨西哥盆地经典期规划大都，含太阳/月亮金字塔与羽蛇神庙等巨构（UNESCO 414）。
statement.en: UNESCO frames Teotihuacan as a planned Classic metropolis in the Basin of Mexico with monumental pyramids and the Temple of Quetzalcoatl (UNESCO 414).
